findings.text: 目标是会离开后继续的长会话用户。原来要返回后手动compact或让宿主在压力下压缩；此插件把同一摘要请求提前到空闲期，用户回来再决定应用。合格交付是原有上下文被正确摘要且下一步可继续，不是仅出现按钮。相对提前自动压缩，其增量是分离准备和提交、保留用户控制；相对手动压缩，它引入可能根本不会使用的预付摘要成本。

prepare先确认idle、正常turn结束、无后台活动、压缩和token服务可用且达到阈值。它用当前Session构造器复制事件到分离会话，将compactNow作用于副本，记录该异步调用链中的摘要流。apply调用真实commands.execute('/compact')，仅对provider、model、maxTokens、tools、toolHistory和messages构成的相同请求回放一次。依赖timer、commands、llm、sessions、connection及agent作用域内compaction服务；宿主API变化会影响副本和请求匹配。
README声明DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3和0.2.1-rc.2测试；本轮未重跑。

#### 成本
| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | Web宿主资源，金额未知 | 配阈值与延迟，耗时未知 | 需匹配宿主API |
| 持续使用 | 每次准备一次摘要调用与内存 | 观察账单和摘要质量 | 缓存命中及应用概率未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 不匹配可能追加新模型调用 | 手动compact或重试 | abort计费未知 |
经常在超长会话停顿后返回、能核查供应商缓存计费的Web用户可在非关键会话试用。先确认正常idle才准备、恢复活动后失效、应用只回放相同请求，随后用同任务检查摘要遗漏与下一轮费用。以总尝试账单和合格接续共同验收，不能只看应用时零新请求。频繁废弃会话、缓存不可观测或严格保留全部历史的用户先观察；若净费用增加、摘要漏掉关键约束或宿主升级导致匹配失常，应停用。 [Q06](#research-q06)

#### 效果
| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 不提前改活会话 | 分离copy接收compact | 宿主新版本兼容 |
| 避免重复相同请求 | 匹配后仅回放一次 | 总账单是否下降 |
| 失效保护 | surface签名与请求键 | 关键约束保真与完整接续 |
PreparedStore单一拥有准备状态，RequestReplay用AsyncLocalStorage隔离并发范围，调度器独立处理abort，值得借鉴。移植需要稳定会话surface版本和可在副本运行的压缩服务；这些宿主内部约定是维护成本。
[Q01](#research-q01) 的贡献是将摘要计算与会话提交分离，复用宿主compact而保留用户确认；[Q02](#research-q02) 的异步作用域使普通并发调用不误用准备结果。属于预计算与事务式确认的具体组合，未证明算法原创或净节费。
[Q03](#research-q03) 说明缓存寿命只是延迟配置代理，摘要失效保护解决正确性的一部分，却不能证明预付请求比手动压缩更经济。供应商缓存与用户回访概率是核心限制。
[Q05](#research-q05) 提出未验证的返回概率及cache usage联动策略。须对比总成本、合格接续和等待时间，任何质量下降或净费用上升都会削弱它。

technical.rationale: novelty体现宿主摘要预计算与请求一次回放组合；mechanism分离会话和异步作用域改变安全取舍；transferability需宿主提供可重放会话；simplification复用compact但增加失效状态，未证净收益。

business.rationale: workflow将计算移到用户离开期间；delivery仍为同一摘要；reach限Web和长会话；economics存在条件性缓存机会，废弃请求削弱收益。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-idle-compact [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that prepares a compaction of a long session while you are away, before the model provider's KV cache expires, and lets you apply it with one click when you come back.

## Why

Providers cache the prompt prefix of a conversation for a few minutes. While the cache is warm, re-reading a long history is cheap. Once it expires, your next message re-bills the whole history at the full, uncached input price.

If you walk away from a long session, this plugin produces the compaction summary while the cache is still warm, so that summarization request is cheap. Nothing changes in your session until you decide to apply it.

## How it works

1. When a session finishes a turn and waits for you, a timer starts.
2. Any new activity in that session cancels the timer, whether it's you replying or the agent starting work.
3. When the timer fires, the plugin prepares a compaction only if all of these hold:
   - the agent is still idle and its last turn finished normally (not an error or a stop);
   - no background job or subagent is running for the session;
   - the session's context, measured with DSH's token meter, has reached the threshold.
4. Preparing runs exactly the summarization request DSH's `/compact` would make, and keeps the result. Your session is not changed.
5. An **Apply compaction** bar appears just above the message input, showing how many history items it covers.
6. Clicking it runs DSH's own `/compact` command, exactly as if you had typed it, and answers its summarization request with the prepared result, so no new model call is made. The conversation shows the usual `/compact` card with its "Compacted N history items" reply.

The prepared summary is only valid for the conversation it summarized. If you send another message (or the history changes in any other way), it is discarded and the button disappears; the next idle period that qualifies prepares a fresh one. If the conversation somehow differs at the moment you click, `/compact` makes its own model call instead of using a stale summary.

When the plugin starts or is reloaded (a DSH restart, a plugin update), sessions that are already waiting are timed from the end of their last turn. A session idle for less than the idle delay is timed for only the remaining seconds. A session idle for longer is skipped entirely, because the provider's cache has most likely expired and preparing would cost full price. It qualifies again after its next turn.

Subagent sessions are skipped, because they never wait for a user reply. If the agent is busy when the timer fires, nothing is prepared and this is logged.

## Settings

Open **Plugins → Idle Compact** in the DSH Web UI:

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Context length threshold (tokens) | `256000` | Prepare a compaction only when the session context has reached this length. |
| Idle time (seconds) | `300` (5 min) | How long you must go without replying before a compaction is prepared. |

Both fields take whole numbers of at least 1. Changes apply without a restart. A changed idle time takes effect the next time a session starts waiting.

You can also set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: idle-compact
  config:
    contextThresholdTokens: 200000
    idleSeconds: 240
```

## Install

Requires the DSH Web UI. Tested on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 and 0.2.1-rc.2; earlier versions are untested. The plugin uses DSH's authenticated `/api` routes, its settings-form components, and the area above the message input (`conversation.input.dock`).

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact
```

Or, in the Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact` or a local checkout path.

## Token cost

Each prepared compaction makes one summarization call to your model. It's cheap because the cache is warm, but it is spent even if you never click Apply or never return to that session. If most of your idle sessions are ones you abandon, raise the threshold.

Prepared summaries are kept in memory only. Restarting DSH discards them.

## Page endpoints

The browser half talks to the Host over two routes on DSH's own `/api` channel. DSH checks the browser's login and origin before either route runs, so other programs and other websites can't use them.

- `GET /api/idle-compact/events?sessionId=<id>`: a server-sent event stream. The first message is the session's current state, and another follows each change. Each message is `{ "prepared": false }`, or `{ "prepared": true, "items": <history items>, "tokens": <approx. tokens>, "applying": <boolean> }`.
- `POST /api/idle-compact/apply` with JSON `{ "sessionId": "<id>" }` applies the prepared compaction. Responses:

| Status | Body | When |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | `{ "ok": <boolean>, "result": <command result> }` | `/compact` ran; `ok` is whether it succeeded. Its outcome also shows in the chat. |
| 200 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "command-unavailable" }` | The `/compact` command isn't available. |
| 400 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "bad-body" }` | The body isn't a JSON object with a non-empty string `sessionId`. |
| 404 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "no-session" }` | No live session has that id. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "not-prepared" }` | Nothing is prepared, or it went stale. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "applying" }` | An apply is already running for that session. |
| 500 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "failed", "message": "…" }` | Applying failed unexpectedly. |

## Tests

```sh
npm test
```

The tests load the plugin into a real DSH runtime from your local DSH install and fake only the model provider and the browser connection. Set `DSH_RUNTIME_DIRS` (colon-separated `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` directories) to choose which runtimes to test against.

## Files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: settings schema, public exports, and wiring of the parts below. |
| `src/idle-scheduler.js` | One idle timer per agent; aborts its work when the agent resumes. |
| `src/prepare.js` | Eligibility checks, and producing the summary on a detached copy of the session. |
| `src/replay.js` | Records the summarization request while preparing; replays it once on apply. |

      "content": "/**
 * Idle Compact — Host half.
 *
 * When a user-facing agent goes idle, arm a timer. If the user has not woken the agent
 * before it fires, its last turn finished normally, no background job or subagent is
 * running, and the measured context has reached the threshold, the plugin PREPARES a
 * compaction: it runs DSH's own `/compact` summarization once, while the provider's KV
 * cache is still warm, and keeps the result without changing the session. The page then
 * shows an "Apply compaction" bar. Clicking it runs the real `/compact` command; while
 * that runs, the plugin answers its one summarization request with the prepared result,
 * so applying makes no new LLM call and the chat shows the ordinary `/compact` card and
 * "Compacted N history items" reply.
 *
 * A prepared result is valid only for the exact conversation it summarized: any change to
 * the model-visible history discards it, and the replay is used only for a request that is
 * byte-for-byte the one recorded. Otherwise `/compact` simply makes its own fresh call.
 *
 * This file wires the parts together and owns the public exports:
 * - src/idle-scheduler.js — idle timers;
 * - src/prepare.js — eligibility checks and producing the summary on a detached copy;
 * - src/replay.js — recording the summarization request and replaying it on apply;
 * - src/prepared-store.js — what is prepared per session, and its change notifications;
 * - src/http.js — the page's endpoints on DSH's authenticated `/api` channel.
 */
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
import { AGENT, APPLY_CODE, API_ROUTES, COMPACTION, DEFAULTS, PLUGIN_NAME, SERVICE } from './src/constants.js'
import { registerRoutes } from './src/http.js'
import { IdleScheduler } from './src/idle-scheduler.js'
import { PreparedStore, surfaceSignature } from './src/prepared-store.js'
import { checkEligible, lastTurnEnd, prepareCompaction, START_SKIP } from './src/prepare.js'
import { RequestReplay } from './src/replay.js'
import { errorText, live } from './src/util.js'

export { APPLY_CODE, API_ROUTES, DEFAULTS }

export const name = PLUGIN_NAME

/**
 * `ctx.timeout()` is a mixin of the `timer` service, and Cordis exposes service mixins
 * only to plugins that declare the service. Undeclared, the idle timer threw
 * "cannot get property "timer" without inject" inside the `agent/status` listener; the
 * agent event dispatcher logs and swallows listener errors, so nothing ever ran.
 * `commands` executes `/compact`, `llm` carries the summarization request and its
 * `llm/stream` interception hook, `sessions` resolves sessions by id and supplies message
 * projections for the detached copy, and `connection` serves the page's endpoints behind
 * DSH's browser login. Without any of them this plugin has no work, so all are required.
 */
export const inject = ['timer', 'commands', 'llm', 'sessions', 'connection']

/**
 * `.volatile()` fields are what the Settings service exposes as an editable form;
 * the client page edits them through `configForms` and the Host reads them live.
 */
export const Config = z.object({
  contextThresholdTokens: z.number().step(1).min(1).default(DEFAULTS.contextThresholdTokens)
    .description('Prepare a compaction only when the session context has reached this many tokens.').volatile(),
  idleSeconds: z.number().step(1).min(1).default(DEFAULTS.idleSeconds)
    .description('Seconds without a user reply before a compaction is prepared.').volatile(),
})

export function apply(ctx, config) {
  const logger = ctx.logger(name)
  const lookup = (sessionId) => ctx.sessions.get(sessionId)
  const store = new PreparedStore(lookup)
  const replay = new RequestReplay(logger)
  /** Cleanups run when the plugin unloads, in registration order. */
  const cleanups = []
  /** Applies in flight, aborted when the plugin unloads. */
  const applying = new Set()

  /** Prepare a compaction for an agent whose idle delay elapsed, if it qualifies. */
  const onIdle = async (agent, signal) => {
    const session = agent.session
    try {
      const threshold = live(config.contextThresholdTokens, DEFAULTS.contextThresholdTokens)
      const check = await checkEligible(ctx, agent, threshold, () => store.current(session) !== undefined)
      if (check.skip !== undefined) {
        logger.info('session %s: idle compaction skipped (%s)', agent.id, check.skip)
        return
      }
      logger.info('session %s idle with ~%d tokens (>= %d); preparing compaction', agent.id, check.tokens, threshold)
      const entry = await prepareCompaction(ctx, replay, agent, check.compaction, signal)
      if (entry === undefined) logger.info('session %s: nothing compactable', agent.id)
      // The user may have resumed while the summary was produced; keep only a still-current result.
      else if (signal.aborted || agent.status !== AGENT.statusIdle || entry.signature !== surfaceSignature(session)) logger.info('session %s changed while preparing; discarded', agent.id)
      else {
        store.set(session, entry)
        logger.info('session %s: compaction prepared (%d items, ~%d tokens)', agent.id, entry.items, entry.tokens)
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!signal.aborted) logger.warn('session %s: idle compaction was not prepared: %s', agent.id, errorText(error))
    }
  }

  const scheduler = new IdleScheduler(ctx, () => live(config.idleSeconds, DEFAULTS.idleSeconds), onIdle)

  /** Apply the prepared compaction through the real `/compact` command. */
  const applyPrepared = async (session) => {
    const entry = store.current(session)
    if (entry === undefined) return { ok: false, code: APPLY_CODE.notPrepared }
    if (store.isApplying(session)) return { ok: false, code: APPLY_CODE.applying }
    const controller = new AbortController()
    applying.add(controller)
    store.beginApply(session)
    try {
      const execution = await replay.replay(entry, () => ctx.commands.execute(entry.agent, COMPACTION.commandLine, COMPACTION.noAttachments, controller.signal))
      if (execution === undefined) return { ok: false, code: APPLY_CODE.commandUnavailable }
      return { ok: execution.result.kind === COMPACTION.resultSuccess, result: execution.result }
    } finally {
      applying.delete(controller)
      store.endApply(session)
    }
  }

  ctx.on('llm/stream', (options, next) => replay.intercept(options, next))

  ctx.on('agent/status', ({ agent, status }) => {
    if (status === AGENT.statusIdle) { scheduler.arm(agent); return }
    scheduler.disarm(agent)
    // The conversation is moving on; a prepared summary would be stale.
    store.drop(agent.session)
  })

  // An agent starts life idle and DSH reports no status change for it: a session resumed
  // after a restart, or reopened later, would otherwise never arm a timer until its next
  // turn. Arm it here too; if it is woken right away, `agent/status` disarms it again.
  // Serial listener: return immediately so agent creation is not delayed.
  ctx.on('agent/created', ({ agent }) => {
    if (agent.status === AGENT.statusIdle) scheduler.arm(agent)
  })

  // The same gap after a reload: a plugin update or profile recomposition restarts this
  // plugin while sessions already wait idle, and neither event above fires for them.
  // Only sessions idle for less than the idle delay are armed, for the rest of it: the
  // delay is the plugin's stand-in for the provider's KV-cache lifetime (the user's rule),
  // so a session idle longer has a cold cache and preparing it would pay full input price.
  // A session with no finished turn has no idle start to measure, so it is skipped too.
  for (const agent of ctx.get(SERVICE.agents)?.list() ?? []) {
    if (agent.status !== AGENT.statusIdle) continue
    const idleSinceMs = lastTurnEnd(agent.session)?.time
    if (idleSinceMs === undefined) continue
    const elapsedMs = Math.max(0, Date.now() - idleSinceMs)
    if (elapsedMs < scheduler.delayMs()) scheduler.arm(agent, elapsedMs)
    else logger.info('session %s: idle compaction skipped (%s)', agent.id, START_SKIP.cacheExpired)
  }

  // History changed without a turn (another plugin's message, a rewind): drop the summary.
  ctx.on('session/event', (session) => store.revalidate(session))

  ctx.on('agent/disposed', ({ agent }) => {
    scheduler.disarm(agent)
    store.drop(agent.session)
  })

  registerRoutes(ctx, { store, lookup, applyPrepared, onDispose: (cleanup) => cleanups.push(cleanup) })

  ctx.effect(() => () => {
    scheduler.disarmAll()
    for (const controller of applying) controller.abort()
    applying.clear()
    for (const cleanup of cleanups) cleanup()
  }, 'idle-compact: lifecycle')
}

      "content": "/**
 * Decide whether an idle session qualifies, and produce its compaction summary without
 * touching the live session.
 */
import { AGENT, BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_KINDS, COMPACTION, SERVICE, SESSION_ACTIVITY_EVENT, SESSION_EVENT } from './constants.js'
import { surfaceSignature } from './prepared-store.js'

/**
 * Resolve a service as the agent sees it. Compaction is mounted inside each agent
 * preset's isolated group, so the root context alone may not carry it.
 */
function serviceFor(ctx, agent, key) {
  return agent.ctx?.get?.(key)
    ?? ctx.get(SERVICE.agentPresets)?.serviceFor?.(agent, key)
    ?? ctx.get(key)
}

/** The session's latest `turn/end` event, or undefined when no turn has ended yet. */
export function lastTurnEnd(session) {
  for (let seq = session.seq - 1; seq >= 0; seq -= 1) {
    const event = session.eventAt(seq)
    if (event?.type === SESSION_EVENT.turnEnd) return event
  }
  return undefined
}

/** Whether the session's latest turn ended normally (the agent finished, not failed or stopped). */
function lastTurnCompleted(session) {
  return lastTurnEnd(session)?.data.reason?.kind === SESSION_EVENT.turnCompleted
}

/** Whether jobs or subagents still run for this session, per DSH's own activity providers. */
async function hasBackgroundWork(ctx, session) {
  const activity = await ctx.waterfall(SESSION_ACTIVITY_EVENT, { sessionId: session.id }, () => Promise.resolve([]))
  return activity.some((family) => BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_KINDS.includes(family.kind) && family.items.length > 0)
}

/** Why an idle session was not eligible; `eligible` carries what preparing needs. */
export const SKIP = Object.freeze({
  busy: 'busy',
  turnNotCompleted: 'turn-not-completed',
  backgroundWork: 'background-work',
  servicesUnavailable: 'services-unavailable',
  belowThreshold: 'below-threshold',
  alreadyPrepared: 'already-prepared',
})

/** Why an agent already idle when the plugin starts was not armed. */
export const START_SKIP = Object.freeze({
  cacheExpired: 'cache-expired',
})

/**
 * Check every condition for preparing, in order, and say which one failed.
 * @param ctx - plugin context.
 * @param agent - the idle agent.
 * @param thresholdTokens - context size that must be reached.
 * @param isPrepared - whether a current entry already exists; asked last, because asking
 *   drops an entry that went stale.
 * @returns `{ skip }` naming the first failed condition, or `{ compaction, tokens }`.
 */
export async function checkEligible(ctx, agent, thresholdTokens, isPrepared) {
  if (agent.status !== AGENT.statusIdle) return { skip: SKIP.busy }
  if (!lastTurnCompleted(agent.session)) return { skip: SKIP.turnNotCompleted }
  if (await hasBackgroundWork(ctx, agent.session)) return { skip: SKIP.backgroundWork }
  const meter = serviceFor(ctx, agent, SERVICE.tokenMeter)
  const compaction = serviceFor(ctx, agent, SERVICE.compaction)
  if (meter === undefined || compaction === undefined) return { skip: SKIP.servicesUnavailable }
  const tokens = meter.measure(agent.session).totalTokens
  if (tokens < thresholdTokens) return { skip: SKIP.belowThreshold, tokens }
  if (isPrepared()) return { skip: SKIP.alreadyPrepared, tokens }
  return { compaction, tokens }
}

/**
 * A detached replay of the session's log. DSH's `Session` class is reached through the
 * live instance rather than imported, so the copy is built by exactly the runtime that
 * built the session (a profile plugin may otherwise resolve a different dsh-session).
 * Appends to a detached session notify no observer and reach no persistence.
 */
function detachedCopy(ctx, session) {
  return session.constructor.create(session.id, session.snapshotEvents(), session.header, session.inheritedEventCount, ctx.sessions.messageProjections)
}

/** The successful compaction a run appended to `session` at or after `fromSeq`, if any. */
function committedSummary(session, fromSeq) {
  let summary
  for (let seq = fromSeq; seq < session.seq; seq += 1) {
    const event = session.eventAt(seq)
    if (event.type === SESSION_EVENT.compactionSummary) summary = event.data
    if (event.type === SESSION_EVENT.compactionEnd) return event.data.error === undefined ? summary : undefined
  }
  return undefined
}

/**
 * Record DSH's `/compact` summarization for this session without committing it. The
 * engine's normal `compactNow` runs against a detached copy: it selects the range, sends
 * the request (recorded by `replay`), and commits only to the copy, which is then
 * discarded. The live session is never written and its agent is never blocked.
 * @returns the PreparedEntry, or undefined when there was nothing to compact.
 */
export async function prepareCompaction(ctx, replay, agent, compaction, signal) {
  const session = agent.session
  const signature = surfaceSignature(session)
  const copy = detachedCopy(ctx, session)
  const fromSeq = copy.seq
  const proxy = {
    session: copy,
    options: agent.options,
    // The copy has no driver to serialize against; run the job under this operation's signal.
    runMaintenance: (job) => job(signal),
  }
  const { recording } = await replay.record(async () => {
    try {
      await compaction.compactNow(proxy, signal)
    } catch (error) {
      // The engine ends with a durability checkpoint (`sessions.flush`) that only a live,
      // persisted session can pass. The summary is committed to the copy before it, so
      // this one failure still leaves a complete result to read below.
      if (error?.code !== COMPACTION.persistenceFailureCode) throw error
    }
  })
  const summary = committedSummary(copy, fromSeq)
  if (summary === undefined || recording.key === undefined) return undefined
  return { agent, key: recording.key, chunks: recording.chunks, signature, items: summary.shadowedSeqs.length, tokens: summary.shadowedTokenCount }
}

      "content": "/**
 * Record DSH's summarization request while a compaction is prepared, and answer the
 * identical request from that recording when the user applies it.
 */
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks'
import { COMPACTION } from './constants.js'

/**
 * Identity of one summarization request: everything the engine sends to the provider.
 * The recorded result is replayed only for a request with this exact identity, which
 * proves `/compact` selected the same history and would have sent the same prompt.
 */
export function requestKey(options) {
  return JSON.stringify([options.provider, options.model, options.maxTokens ?? null, options.tools ?? null, options.toolHistory ?? null, options.messages])
}

/** Pass a stream through while keeping every chunk for later replay. */
async function* recordStream(stream, chunks) {
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    chunks.push(chunk)
    yield chunk
  }
}

/** Replay recorded chunks as a stream; consumers only iterate it. */
async function* replayStream(chunks) {
  yield* chunks
}

/**
 * Which `llm/stream` calls belong to this plugin. The store follows the async call chain
 * from `compactNow` into the request, so a concurrent request for the same session id
 * (the agent's own turn, a typed `/compact`) is never recorded or answered from cache.
 */
export class RequestReplay {
  #scope = new AsyncLocalStorage()
  #logger

  constructor(logger) {
    this.#logger = logger
  }

  /**
   * Run `operation` while recording its summarization request.
   * @returns the operation's result and the recording (`key` undefined when no request was made).
   */
  async record(operation) {
    const recording = { key: undefined, chunks: [] }
    const result = await this.#scope.run({ recording }, operation)
    return { result, recording }
  }

  /** Run `operation` so its first identical summarization request is answered from `recording`. */
  replay(recording, operation) {
    return this.#scope.run({ replayFrom: recording, replayed: false }, operation)
  }

  /**
   * `llm/stream` waterfall listener. Every request outside this plugin's scope, or not
   * a summarization, passes through untouched; a waterfall listener must always delegate.
   */
  intercept(options, next) {
    const marker = this.#scope.getStore()
    if (marker === undefined || options.purpose !== COMPACTION.requestPurpose) return next()
    const key = requestKey(options)
    if (marker.recording !== undefined) {
      // Keep the LAST request: if the engine's summary-error recovery retries, the retry's
      // response is the one that produced the committed summary.
      marker.recording.key = key
      marker.recording.chunks = []
      return recordStream(next(), marker.recording.chunks)
    }
    // Replay at most once, and only for the identical request. Work the apply schedules
    // (a turn woken when maintenance ends) inherits this async context; its own pressure
    // compaction asks something different, or comes after the replay, and goes to the model.
    if (marker.replayed || marker.replayFrom.key !== key) {
      if (!marker.replayed) this.#logger.info('session %s: compaction request differs from the prepared one; making a fresh call', options.sessionId)
      return next()
    }
    marker.replayed = true
    this.#logger.info('session %s: applying prepared compaction without a new LLM call', options.sessionId)
    return replayStream(marker.replayFrom.chunks)
  }
}

      "path": "src/prepared-store.js",
      "content": "/**
 * The one owner of "what is prepared for which session". It holds each session's
 * prepared entry and apply flag, decides when an entry has gone stale, and tells the
 * page's open event streams whenever a session's state changes.
 */

/**
 * Model-visible history identity. Surface nodes change only by append (length) or
 * replacement (content generation), so log-only events — including the `command/run`
 * and `compaction/start` that applying itself writes — leave it unchanged.
 * @param session - live DSH session.
 * @returns opaque signature of what the model would see.
 */
export function surfaceSignature(session) {
  return `${session.surface.contentGeneration}:${session.surface.nodes.length}`
}

/**
 * @typedef {object} PreparedEntry
 * @property {object} agent - agent whose `/compact` will be run on apply.
 * @property {string} key - identity of the recorded summarization request.
 * @property {unknown[]} chunks - recorded response stream chunks.
 * @property {string} signature - `surfaceSignature` when the summary was produced.
 * @property {number} items - history items the summary replaces.
 * @property {number} tokens - approximate tokens the summary replaces.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {{ prepared: false } | { prepared: true, items: number, tokens: number, applying: boolean }} PreparedState
 * The page-facing state of one session (sent on each event-stream frame).
 */

const NOT_PREPARED = Object.freeze({ prepared: false })

export class PreparedStore {
  /** session -> PreparedEntry; weak, so a disposed session's entry goes with it */
  #entries = new WeakMap()
  /** sessions applying their prepared compaction right now */
  #applying = new WeakSet()
  /** sessionId -> listeners of open event streams */
  #watchers = new Map()
  #lookup

  /** @param lookup - resolve a session id to its live session, or undefined. */
  constructor(lookup) {
    this.#lookup = lookup
  }

  /**
   * The page-facing state for a session id; unknown ids are simply not prepared.
   * @param sessionId - session id from the page.
   * @returns {PreparedState}
   */
  stateOf(sessionId) {
    const session = this.#lookup(sessionId)
    const entry = session === undefined ? undefined : this.#entries.get(session)
    return entry === undefined
      ? NOT_PREPARED
      : { prepared: true, items: entry.items, tokens: entry.tokens, applying: this.#applying.has(session) }
  }

  /**
   * The prepared entry for a session, dropped if the visible history changed since.
   * @returns {PreparedEntry | undefined}
   */
  current(session) {
    const entry = this.#entries.get(session)
    if (entry === undefined || entry.signature === surfaceSignature(session)) return entry
    this.drop(session)
    return undefined
  }

  /** Store a freshly prepared entry and notify watchers. */
  set(session, entry) {
    this.#entries.set(session, entry)
    this.#publish(session)
  }

  /** Discard a session's entry, if any, and notify watchers. */
  drop(session) {
    if (this.#entries.delete(session)) this.#publish(session)
  }

  /** Re-check staleness after a log append, except while applying writes its own events. */
  revalidate(session) {
    if (this.#entries.has(session) && !this.#applying.has(session)) this.current(session)
  }

  isApplying(session) {
    return this.#applying.has(session)
  }

  /** Mark the session as applying; watchers see `applying: true`. */
  beginApply(session) {
    this.#applying.add(session)
    this.#publish(session)
  }

  /** An apply attempt consumes the entry whatever its outcome. */
  endApply(session) {
    this.#applying.delete(session)
    this.#entries.delete(session)
    this.#publish(session)
  }

  /**
   * Follow a session's state. The listener receives the current state at once and again
   * after every change, until the returned disposer runs.
   * @param sessionId - session id from the page.
   * @param listener - receives each PreparedState.
   * @returns disposer.
   */
  watch(sessionId, listener) {
    const session = this.#lookup(sessionId)
    if (session !== undefined) this.current(session)
    const listeners = this.#watchers.get(sessionId) ?? new Set()
    listeners.add(listener)
    this.#watchers.set(sessionId, listeners)
    listener(this.stateOf(sessionId))
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener)
      if (listeners.size === 0 && this.#watchers.get(sessionId) === listeners) this.#watchers.delete(sessionId)
    }
  }

  #publish(session) {
    const listeners = this.#watchers.get(session.id)
    if (listeners === undefined) return
    const state = this.stateOf(session.id)
    for (const listener of listeners) listener(state)
  }
}

      "content": "/**
 * One idle timer per user-facing agent, and the abortable preparation it may start.
 * The scheduler knows nothing about compaction: when a timer fires it calls `onIdle`
 * with an AbortSignal that aborts as soon as the agent leaves idle or the plugin unloads.
 */
import { AGENT, MS_PER_SECOND } from './constants.js'

export class IdleScheduler {
  /** agent -> disposer of its pending idle timer */
  #timers = new Map()
  /** agent -> controller of the work its timer started */
  #working = new Map()
  #ctx
  #delaySeconds
  #onIdle

  /**
   * @param ctx - plugin context (provides `timeout`).
   * @param delaySeconds - reads the current idle delay in seconds.
   * @param onIdle - `(agent, signal) => Promise<void>` run when the delay elapses.
   */
  constructor(ctx, delaySeconds, onIdle) {
    this.#ctx = ctx
    this.#delaySeconds = delaySeconds
    this.#onIdle = onIdle
  }

  /** The configured idle delay, in milliseconds. */
  delayMs() {
    return this.#delaySeconds() * MS_PER_SECOND
  }

  /**
   * Start (or restart) the idle timer for an agent that is waiting for the user.
   * @param agent - the idle agent.
   * @param elapsedMs - how long it has already been idle; the timer runs only for the rest
   *   of the delay. Callers ensure it is below `delayMs()`.
